scope: Agent-neutral workflow invocation for AHRA workflow modules.
changes: Documented ADR-0005 for agent-neutral workflow invocation.
Added architecture documentation for AgentDriver roles, driver registry, and WorkflowRunRequest launch semantics.
Added local skill instructions for workflow module startup.
Converted AgentDriver to a role-based run(request) port.
Added AgentDriverRegistry and stable run_workflow API.
Added tests for driver registry and WorkflowRunRequest startup.
Added fail-closed WorkflowRunRequest validation in the document loader and direct run_workflow API path.
Made approvalMode drive LoopEngineering planner behavior: manual pauses on proposals, auto executes proposals within limits, and disabled blocks without planner proposals.
Tightened embedded task and goal schema shapes while keeping policy optional.
Fixed default ChangePolicy loading for schema-valid embedded tasks without a policy field.
Added regression tests for invalid approvalMode, minimal embedded task defaults, and approvalMode behavior.
Promoted AgentDriver, AgentRole, AgentRunRequest, AgentRunResult, and AgentDriverRegistry to AHRA global ports.
Updated workflow module contracts so standard-harness and loop-engineering require AgentDriver but do not require ProjectAdapter or ModelGateway.
Changed run_workflow to resolve the workflow module registry and reference dispatcher before creating any artifact store.
Added regression tests for missing AgentDriver module contracts and unknown workflow modules leaving no artifact directory.
